description.value: 40 Knots is one of Vancouver Island's largest wineries, farming 24 acres of ocean-cooled vineyards in the Comox Valley. Visitors can explore interpretive trails, stroll gardens, or relax on a terrace with vineyard and ocean views while tasting sustainably produced wines. The winery emphasizes organic and biodynamic farming practices shaped by its proximity to the Salish Sea.
